findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.111(C) Controlling Pests. The PREMISES shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests shall be controlled to eliminate their presence on the PREMISES by: (C) Using methods, if pests are found, such as trapping devices or other means of pest control as specified under §§ 7-202.12, 7-206.12, and 7-206.13.

Numerous flies were observed remaining near the dish machine in the bakery area. The PIC was shown and instructed to continue remediation actions to remove the remaining pests. The other store locations previously noted (ie. the mop room and onion pallet) appear CORRECTED at the time of the inspection. A follow-up was scheduled for two weeks to allow for the remaining flies to be removed.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.111(C) Controlling Pests. The PREMISES shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests shall be controlled to eliminate their presence on the PREMISES by: (C) Using methods, if pests are found, such as trapping devices or other means of pest control as specified under §§ 7-202.12, 7-206.12, and 7-206.13.

Numerous flies were observed remaining near the dish machine in the bakery and the onion pallet in the back stock area. The PIC was made aware of the fly issue, inspector instructed PIC to contact their pest control company. A follow up is being set for one month from inspection date to allow time for adequate pest control to be conducted for the ongoing pest issue.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Observed the hand wash sink in the bakery area obstructed by racks of baked bread making access to hand sink difficult. The hand sink is located near the walk in cooler door that swings open into the area person using hand sink has to stand. Racks of baked bread were moved to allow access to the hand sink. Ensure that all hand sinks are stocked and accessible at all times.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Food properly labeled; original container.
findings.comment: Observed white powders in storage containers unlabeled. PIC was made aware that powders not in original containers need to be labeled so they can be identified. Ensure ingredients removed from original packaging are labeled at all times.
findings.citation_text: 3-302.12 Food Storage Containers, Identified with Common Name of Food. Except for containers holding FOOD that can be readily and unmistakably recognized such as dry pasta, working containers holding FOOD or FOOD ingredients that are removed from their original packages for use in the FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, such as cooking oils, flour, herbs, potato flakes, salt, spices, and sugar shall be identified with the common name of the FOOD.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.comment: Observed light coming through back door in storage area. PIC was notified that weather striping or another form of seal should be installed to seal the door prior to the next routine inspection. Ensure that the facility is protected from pest entering through this opening.
findings.citation_text: 6-202.15(A) Outer Openings, Protected. (A) Except as specified in (B), (C), and (E) and under (D) of this section, outer openings of a FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by: (1) Filling or closing holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings; (2) Closed, tight-fitting windows; and (3) Solid, self-closing, tight-fitting doors.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.

PIC was made aware of the fly issue, inspector instructed PIC to contact their pest control company. findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed ceiling tile to have vinyl layer peeling way from its base in the rack storage area of the bakery. PIC was notified to replace the ceiling tile. Ensure that the floors, walls, and ceilings are all smooth and easily cleanable at all times.
findings.citation_text: 6-201.11 Floors, Walls, and Ceilings. Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used.
findings.comment: In the back storage area there were multiple personal drinks observed to be stored intermixed with products intended for consumers. PIC was notified that employee drinks should not be stored in the storage area intermixed with consumer products. Bottles were removed and discarded by PIC to correct the violation. Ensure that employee food and drinks are stored separately from products intended for consumers.
findings.citation_text: 6-403.11(A) Designated Areas. (A) Areas designated for EMPLOYEES to eat, drink, and use TOBACCO PRODUCTS shall be located so that FOOD, EQUIPMENT, LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES are protected from contamination.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

The ice machine in the back area used by multiple departments (including bakery) has globs of black slime/mold observed around the internal chute opening. The PIC was shown and instructed to clean and maintain clean at all times. The equipment was cleaned/sanitized during this inspection to correct. Ensure that all food contact surfaces are maintained clean at all times.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.111(C) Controlling Pests. The PREMISES shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests shall be controlled to eliminate their presence on the PREMISES by: (C) Using methods, if pests are found, such as trapping devices or other means of pest control as specified under §§ 7-202.12, 7-206.12, and 7-206.13.

Multiple areas in the facility are observed to have multiple fruit flies/gnats/drain flies. Areas include: 1) the bakery dish area; 2) the drain next to the seasoning mixer in the bakery area; 3) the back-stock storage area directly behind the bakery; 4) the chemical room in the back-stock area and; 5) in the room next to the chemical room in the back-stock area. The PIC stated that EcoLab had already been to the facility recently but that they would be contacting them for another visit for the noted areas. A follow up is being set f to check for compliance.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. 

The hand sink next to the walk in freezer in the bakery area is pulling away from the wall exposing a gap/crack that needs repaired. The PIC was shown and instructed to re-seal prior to the next routine inspection. Ensure smooth and easily cleanable surfaces throughout the facility, and especially around areas regularly exposed to moisture.

findings.title: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control
findings.comment:
4-301.11: EQUIPMENT for cooling and heating FOOD, and holding cold and hot FOOD, shall be sufficient in number and capacity to provide FOOD temperatures. 

The open sided cooler on the end of isle 16 is registering air temperatures on the bottom shelf in the 48F-55F range. Hams in this cooler are observed with internal temperatures of 44F-48F. The PIC asked employees who stated that the hams had been stocked approximately one hour prior to observation. The hams were allowed to be moved to another cooler to save. This indicates that the cooler is malfunctioning however and needs maintenance conducted. The PIC called RW Refrigeration and they arrived during this inspection. They believed that a valve was the issue and replaced it during this inspection to correct. A spot check will take place in the future to verify the repair was successful.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used
findings.comment:
6-403.11: (A) Areas designated for EMPLOYEES to eat, drink, and use tobacco shall be located so that FOOD, EQUIPMENT, LINENS, and SINGLESERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES are protected from contamination. (B) Lockers or other suitable facilities shall be located in a designated room or area where contamination of FOOD, EQUIPMENT, UTENSILS, LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES cannot occur. 

A consumed can of monster is observed on boxes in the milk walk in cooler. The PIC was shown and instructed to discuss with employees. Foods should not be consumed in areas related to consumer foods storage or preparation. The can was discarded during this inspection to correct the immediate violation.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions. 

The hand sink in the dish area is observed blocked with a tray cart. PIC was consulted and the cart moved to correct.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-202.12: (A) HANDWASHING SINK shall be equipped to provide water of a temperature at least 100F through mixing valve. Pf (B) Steam mixing valve may not be used. (C) A self-closing, slow-closing, or metered faucet shall provide at least 15 seconds of flowing water. (D) An automatic sink shall be installed to manufacturer’s guidelines. 

The hand sink in the dish area does not dispense water at the beginning of this inspection. PIC indicated that the maintenance person was in the building and that they could get the sink into working order during this inspection. The batteries were changed during this inspection but that does not appear to be the issue as the sink still does not function at this time. Follow up will take place in two weeks to ensure repair is completed.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria.

The two buckets of sanitizer in the bakery registered approximately 100 ppm quat on the inspector’s test strips. Employee indicated that the buckets were prepared early in the morning (approximately 6 am). The PIC was instructed to ensure that the buckets were maintained at effective concentration throughout the day. Finding the timing that works for the facility was discussed. The buckets were remade during this inspection to correct the violation.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
3-501.16: (A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less. 

1) Ribs, baked beans, potato salad, macaroni salad and coleslaw are observed with internal temperatures between 48F-50F in the open faced cooler facing the produce area and next to the self checkouts. 2) Ground sausage in the end cap open faced cooler containing sausage, cheese, bacon and summer sausage is observed with internal temperatures between 45F and 49F. This appears to be a stocking issue as the other items in the cooler are within acceptable limits and these are stacked to fill the space completely. Several packages of mozzarella string cheese are also observed out of temperature, but this also appears to be a stocking issue due to locations observed. All TCS items that were observed with internal temperatures out of acceptable limits were discarded during this inspection to correct the violation.

findings.title: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control
findings.comment:
4-301.11: EQUIPMENT for cooling and heating FOOD, and holding cold and hot FOOD, shall be sufficient in number and capacity to provide FOOD temperatures. 

The open faced cooler noted in line item #22 does not appear to be effectively holding TCS foods at acceptable cold holding limits (refer to line item #22). A follow up will be conducted in two weeks to ensure that repairs are completed. PIC contacted the maintinance company during this inspection.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
6-501.111: PREMISE shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. If present (A) Routinely inspect shipments of FOOD and supplies (B) Inspect PREMISE routinely (C) Using methods, such as trapping devices Pf (D) Eliminate harborage conditions. 

Several (at least 10) drain flies are observed in the bakery dish area. Strategies for pest mitigation were discussed and the PIC was instructed to contact their pest control agency (Plunketts) for service. PIC emailed the company during this inspection. Follow up in two weeks for compliance.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
Water not available at the BAKERY handwashing sink near the dish machine. CORRECTED- Battery for the motion-activated sink had been dislodged. Modify battery housing to ensure water is always available at the handwashing sink.
5-202.12: (A) HANDWASHING SINK shall be equipped to provide water of a temperature at least 100F through mixing valve. [Pf]

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition

Bakery-- Opened half gallon of buttermilk observed without date-marking. CORRECTED-- Discussed with staff, who labeled with the date opened.
